dedupe_keys.name: highres high spatial and temporal electricity system model

description: HighRES (high spatial and temporal electricity system model) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by UCL, UiO. The model is used to plan least-cost electricity systems for Europe and specifically designed to analyse the effects of high shares of variable renewables and explore integration/flexibility options. Coverage: EEA+Norway and UK. The fact sheet classes it as: European electricity system model, GB electricity system model. Sectors: Electricity,. Resolution: time Hour, geography Country level, 20 zones for GB. Data availability is given as "all". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
